brief.todays_objective: Move toward independent judgment on discharge timing.
brief.your_role: Let him reach the decision first. Intervene only on safety.
brief.ask_before_explaining: What would you do if the tide window closed early?
watch_for: Whether he checks the salinity trend, not just the instantaneous reading
Whether he considers permit exposure unprompted
brief.knowledge_gap_to_explore: How you decide between delaying discharge and reducing production rate.

transcript: Expert and learner reviewed the discharge window for the north basin. The permitted salinity ceiling is 55 g/L...
notes: The learner raised the tide-window conflict unprompted.

expert_questions.question: What made you treat this window differently from the standard rule?
expert_questions.answer: Four things together -- salinity trend, tide window, a stale sample, and the permit renewal date.

learner_questions.question: Why was nominal cover concerning when it exceeded the threshold?
learner_questions.answer: Because the threshold assumes last month's rate.

learner_questions.question: What if redistribution were not possible?

findings.title: Evidence for Brine Discharge Judgment

body.evidence: Identified that nominal cover overstated real cover because consumption was climbing, and named four converging signals.

findings.rationale: The reasoning was volunteered before the expert explained it, which distinguishes independent judgment from recall.
findings.risk_if_untransferred: Discharge timing decisions would escalate to the regional office, adding days to each cycle.

findings.title: Check neighbouring capacity before emergency procurement

body.situation: Cover appears adequate but the trend is adverse.
observed_signals: Consumption rose sharply over two weeks
Last physical count several days stale
body.expert_reasoning: Any one signal alone is noise. Together they mean the static threshold is measuring the wrong thing.
body.recommended_response: Check genuine surplus at nearby sites before initiating emergency procurement.

findings.rationale: The expert stated a rule she applies but which appears in no written procedure.
findings.risk_if_untransferred: Emergency procurement would be triggered unnecessarily, at roughly three times unit cost.

findings.title: Escalation path not yet demonstrated

body.understands: Can explain when escalation is warranted.
not_yet_demonstrated: Has never initiated an emergency procurement request
Has not negotiated a lead-time exception with a supplier

findings.risk_if_untransferred: The first real escalation after departure would be attempted without precedent.

findings.title: Next: lead a supervised escalation

body.objective: Move Brine Discharge Judgment from level 4 to level 5.
body.recommended_experience: Learner leads the next discharge window end to end, including any escalation.
learner_responsibilities: Make the go/no-go call and state the reasoning first
body.expert_role: Observe. Intervene only on permit or safety exposure.

findings.rationale: Targets the specific gap the session surfaced.
findings.risk_if_untransferred: The capability plateaus at supervised performance.
